title: Anna's Journey
text:
Anna lives in a small town. Every morning she takes the bus to school. The bus is yellow and it is very big. The bus stop is near her house.

On Sunday, Anna goes to the city with her father. They take the train. The train is fast. At the station, they buy two tickets and wait for ten minutes.

questions.text: How does Anna go to school?
How long do they wait at the station?
What can we infer about the city?
options: It is far from Anna's town
It is next to Anna's house

vocabulary.definition: a large vehicle that carries many people along a fixed route
a place where trains or buses stop so people can get on and off
small pieces of paper or cards that you buy to travel

paragraph_translations: Anna mora em uma cidade pequena. Todas as manhãs ela pega o ônibus para ir à escola. O ônibus é amarelo e é muito grande. O ponto de ônibus fica perto da casa dela.
No domingo, Anna vai à cidade com o pai. Eles pegam o trem. O trem é rápido. Na estação, eles compram dois bilhetes e esperam dez minutos.
